notes: Only the listed roots and file types are eligible; other paths are outside the shared scope.
qla2x00t/ is excluded entirely: the legacy QLogic driver is outside the maintained analysis scope.
Only qla2x00t-32gbit/qla2x00-target/ is included from the newer QLogic tree. The remaining driver, including top-level qla_target.c and qla_target.h, is maintained upstream.
KUnit sources under the included roots are eligible regardless of KUNIT_TEST. Selecting sources does not enable them in a build.
